AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `ORDER` o WHERE o.treatment_id = t.id AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SURGERY s WHERE s.id = o.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TEST tst WHERE tst.id = o.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEDICAL_PRESCRIPTION rx WHERE rx.order_id = o.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRANSFERENCE tf WHERE tf.order_id = o.id) ) ) ) ranked WHERE ranked.rn = 1
